title: The Library Book
narration: The final page of my library book described exactly how I would die. The untitled novel documented my entire life, then predicted the librarian locking every exit at 6:14. I resisted its instruction to hide under a desk until something dragged itself between the shelves. Beneath the desk my hand touched cold fingers under the carpet. The librarian approached carrying a blank volume. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. She said readers always obey the ending, and my returned book grew a cover bearing my face and tomorrow's due date.
